technical-summary: A named start of a release installed at another location than the one that wrote the stored manifest is now decided up front as a carry from the engine identity: no replay is attempted (it embedded the old home and crashed with a filesystem error once that prefix was removed), one reuse line says the plan was carried, and the stored measurement is sealed again under this build. New plan-reuse outcome carried. Host test: second prefix, first removed.
user-summary-candidate: Starting an already-measured config from a second install of the same release no longer logs a refusal and still reuses the stored measurement, even after the first install is removed.
